fields.label: Vercel Token
fields.description: Personal access token from https://vercel.com/account/tokens. Used for non-interactive deployments.

fields.label: Team Slug
fields.description: Optional. Vercel team or org slug to deploy under. Leave empty to use your personal account.

fields.label: Deploy to production by default
fields.description: When true, deployments target production unless overridden. When false, preview deployments are the default.
